mechanisms.note: Mildly mispriced against comparables — roughly 2.5-3.5 s.d. from its market. Near the detection boundary: the case that separates a sensitive detector from a blunt one.
Forced or distressed disposal: price marked down, rent unchanged, so the yield rises to roughly 5-7 s.d. above its market.
Trophy asset bid above comparables, compressing the yield to roughly 4-5 s.d. below its market.
Keying error: a digit dropped from the sale price. Grossly outlying and should be caught by any method.

Each value individually unremarkable (each within ~1.5 s.d.); the COMBINATION of elevated yield with unusually low risk is not. Invisible to any single-variable rule — only a multivariate method can recover these.
